name: business_inquiry_greeting
description: A contractor introduces themselves and asks about becoming a supplier relationship. Tests that the AI responds professionally to a B2B-style inquiry and asks what materials or volumes they need.

messages.text: Hi, I'm a contractor looking for a reliable supplier for boards and sheet materials. Do you supply trade customers?

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
Reply should greet the contractor and acknowledge the trade inquiry
Reply should ask what materials, sizes, and volumes the contractor needs

forbidden_patterns.description: No pricing or quotes in the greeting response

notes: The AI should respond professionally, confirm that trade/contractor customers are welcome, and ask for specifics about the materials, board sizes, and quantities needed. It should not promise trade discounts or quote prices without knowing the product and volume. No tools should be called yet.
